english: This is but a room, the voice said, "And your entrance here means nothing. We will leave this place and find another."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"This isn't the first of your cities that have been conquered, shade. I will not give up until you yield. The world is not as big as it once was, when it emerged from winter wild and open. Places to hide are running out."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sandalphon appeared behind him. "What do you want, Decius? A Sidar assassin to strike against your father in Torrolerial? He has his hands full with the Doviello invasion, I think. Would you prefer we poison the Calabim lords? We prefer not to draw the attention of other immortals to ourselves; we are still new at this and they may know more than us."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You know so much about me, do you? I think it is time for you to start answering my questions."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Giving answers isn't what we do. We watch and plan and wait and, if absolutely necessary, we act, without the world knowing we were here. To preserve the Sidar and our seclusion." Sandalphon faded from view again. Decius turned to Vaughn, and the Paladin brought forth a relic of Lugus, flooding the room with light, revealing Sandalphon sitting calmly on his throne. "You seem to have me at a disadvantage. What are your terms?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I want to know why you attacked Ethne and me."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You were both instrumental in leading the war in Tempus Mor, dangerously close to this secluded valley. And you were winning. Based on our observations of your actions in the desert of Myrh, we calculated that an empowered Overcouncil flush with victory would try to expand its position here, attempting to bring us under their 'enlightened' sovereignty. The risk of inaction seemed greater than the risk of action, so we activated our assassins in the region, to attempt to bring a stalemate to the battle and dissuade you from going further. Unfortunately, our plans failed, and here you are."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"This is what you do? You decide who lives and dies based on what you think that they will do?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sandalphon sneered at Decius, the first hint of emotion that he displayed. "You are so much better? You are a ruler-you decide who lives and dies among the untold number that dwell within your borders. Among your soldiers you execute those who betray or desert you, and unleash them on those who would stand against you. You exercise the power of the judge over many, yet you take offense at we who dare to judge only a few, only the kings or priests or generals?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You have no authority over me."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We have the same authority over you that you have over your citizens-we have the power to act on our judgments."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius sighed. "I had come hoping to take you as my vassal, to use you against my enemies. I see now that that would be a foolish plan, only inviting my death or that of my heir. Here is what I propose instead. Give me an advisor. We will leave you to yourselves, to live your long, quiet, isolated lives, but send one of your number to sit in our councils, not as a member but to warn us before you strike. Why should my death be your first course of action?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sandalphon considered him. "This is acceptable. Provided that you personally tell no one of our existence. You can work through your council to see that our few interests are maintained, and we shall likewise leave the world alone for as long as we think wise."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"There is one other condition. I want the soul of Ethne freed. She was slain and cannot be resurrected."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The Elohim woman... Rathus took the Nether Blade when he attacked her, because she knows the secrets of the Mercurian Gate, passed down through the regents of the Elohim."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"There is no point it slaying her for that now; the secret has been used, and spread throughout the Empyrean to Bourne the Gleaming. Release her spirit."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The Nether Blade is an artifact from the underworld. It will draw the soul of anyone it slays into Arawn's realm and anchors them there. Destroying it should free those whose souls belong elsewhere. Free them to serve their true lord, be it in their vault or recalled to Erebus."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Then I shall do so, and free Ethne to return to her people." Decius pulled out the blade that they had taken from Rathus's corpse and studied it for a moment. Green runes pulsed along the light ebon blade.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Behind Sandalphon another Ghost appeared suddenly, drawing their attention. "Belthus, welcome back," Sandalphon said. "How went your mission?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Auric Ulvin's war will not be stopped so easy. I could not get near him. He radiates with the power of Winter, a power not seen on Erebus for generations, and his army grows more numerous. It seems the endless winter is more likely than we thought."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Auric Ulvin? I know that name..." said Decius.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Who is this?" asked Belthus.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Decius leads the Malakim army. They have discovered us, but we have come to an understanding."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Varn Gosam met Auric Ulvin. Varn gave up his vaunted position among a secluded elven tribe to free him, though it would have cost them both their lives had Auric's great power not manifested."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Auric is a magical prodigy, and this power made him a suitable vessel for the machinations of the power of winter. Mulcarn was killed by the Godslayer, leaving his sphere without a suitable ruler. Auric has drawn together the tools of that god, and is preparing to become its avatar. Belthus was sent to stop him, but we acted too late. If the armies gathering against him do not stop him, he will return all Erebus to an Age of Winter."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius looked at the sword he held in his hands for a moment, then he sheathed it. "What if a god was not slain with the Godslayer, but trapped by the Nether Blade?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sandalphon shrugged. "We have no experience with that. I thought you intended to free your friend?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Auric poses a grave threat. We will go to support those who stand against him, and if the Nether Blade staves off this threat for good... I can only hope that Ethne forgives me."
chinese: “这不过是一间屋子，”那声音说，“你踏入此地毫无意义。我们会离开这里，另寻他处。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“这已不是你被攻陷的第一座城了，阴影。你不屈服，我便不会罢休。这世界不像当年从荒野而开阔的寒冬中浮现时那般辽阔了。可供藏身之处正日渐稀少。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]山德尔冯出现在他身后。“你想要什么，德西乌斯？要一名希达刺客去袭杀你在托罗勒里尔的父亲吗？我想他正忙于应付多维洛的入侵。还是你更愿我们毒杀卡拉比姆的领主？我们不愿把其他永生者的注意力引到自己身上；此道我们尚且生疏，他们所知或许胜于我们。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你对我知道得可真不少，是吧？我看，是时候由你来回答我的问题了。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“给出答案并非我们的行事之道。我们观察、谋划、等待，若确有必要，我们便动手，且不让世人知晓我们曾在此地。为的是保全希达一族与我们的隐世。”山德尔冯再度隐入无形。德西乌斯转向沃恩，那位圣骑士取出一件卢古斯的圣物，光芒充溢整间屋子，映出安然端坐王座上的山德尔冯。“看来你占了我的上风。你的条件是什么？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我要知道，你们为何袭击艾斯妮和我。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你二人在坦普斯·摩尔的战争中都举足轻重，而战火危险地逼近这处隐世的山谷。而且你们正节节取胜。依据我们对你们在米尔沙漠中行动的观察，我们推断，一个因胜利而气焰高涨、实力大增的至高议会，会试图向此地扩张，妄图将我们纳入他们‘开明’的统治之下。按兵不动的风险似乎大于出手的风险，于是我们启动了该地区的刺客，试图使这场战役陷入僵局，劝阻你们不再深入。可惜，我们的计划失败了，于是你便到了这里。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你们就是这么干的？凭你们臆测他人将会做什么，就决定谁生谁死？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]山德尔冯朝德西乌斯冷笑，这是他流露的第一丝情绪。“你就高尚得多了？你是一名统治者——在你疆界内栖居的无数生灵中，是你决定谁生谁死。在你的士兵中，你处决那些背叛或逃离你的人，又将他们投向那些胆敢与你为敌之人。你对众多之人行使着审判者的权柄，却对我们这些只敢审判寥寥数人——只敢审判王侯、祭司或将领的人心生怨恨？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你们对我没有任何权柄。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们对你的权柄，与你对你的子民所拥有的一般无二——我们有依自己的裁断而行动的力量。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯叹了口气。“我本是抱着将你收为附庸、用你对付我的敌人的念头而来的。如今我看清了，那会是个愚蠢的打算，只会招致我或我子嗣的死亡。我另有提议。给我一位顾问。我们会任你们自处，去过你们漫长、宁静、与世隔绝的日子，但派你们中的一员坐进我们的议事厅，不作为成员，而是在你们动手之前先警示我们。为何我的死非得是你们的首选之策？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]山德尔冯审视着他。“这可以接受。前提是你本人绝不向任何人透露我们的存在。你可以借你的议会之手，确保我们那寥寥无几的利益得以维护，我们也同样会在我们认为明智的期限内，让这世界安然无扰。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“还有一个条件。我要艾斯妮的灵魂获得自由。她已被杀害，无法复生。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“那埃洛希姆女子……拉萨斯袭击她时取走了冥刃，因为她知晓天界之门的秘密，这秘密由埃洛希姆的摄政者代代相传。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“为此如今再杀她已毫无意义；那秘密已被使用，并经天穹会传遍各处，直至闪光伯恩。释放她的魂灵吧。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“冥刃是一件源自冥界的神器。它会将它所杀之人的灵魂拽入阿劳恩的领域，并将他们锚定在那里。摧毁它，应能释放那些灵魂本属别处之人。放他们去侍奉其真正的主宰，无论是回到他们的灵库，还是被召回埃瑞布斯。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“那我便如此去做，放艾斯妮回到她的族人身边。”德西乌斯抽出他们从拉萨斯尸首上取来的那柄刃，端详片刻。绿色的符文沿着那柄轻盈的乌木之刃搏动着。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]山德尔冯身后又骤然现出一名幽灵，引起了他们的注意。“贝尔萨斯，欢迎归来，”山德尔冯说，“你的任务如何？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“奥里克·尤尔文的战争不会那么轻易被阻止。我无法靠近他。他散发着寒冬之力，那是埃瑞布斯几代未见的力量，而他的军队日益壮大。看来无尽寒冬比我们所想的更有可能降临。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“奥里克·尤尔文？这名字我知道……”德西乌斯说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“这位是谁？”贝尔萨斯问。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“德西乌斯统领着马拉基姆的军队。他们发现了我们，但我们已达成了谅解。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“范恩·哥萨姆见过奥里克·尤尔文。范恩为释放他，放弃了自己在一个隐世精灵部落中备受推崇的地位——若非奥里克那伟力显现，此举本会让他俩都送了命。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“奥里克是个魔法奇才，这份天赋使他成为寒冬之力施展诡计的合适容器。穆卡恩被弑神者所杀，令他的领域失去了合适的统治者。奥里克已将那位神祇的器物聚拢一处，正准备成为它的化身。贝尔萨斯被派去阻止他，但我们行动得太迟了。若聚集起来对抗他的诸军无法阻止他，他将使整个埃瑞布斯重返寒冬纪元。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯凝视着手中的剑片刻，随后将它收入鞘中。“倘若一位神祇不是被弑神者所杀，而是被冥刃困住呢？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]山德尔冯耸了耸肩。“我们对此毫无经验。我原以为你打算去解救你的朋友？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“奥里克构成了严重的威胁。我们会前去支援那些起而抗击他的人，倘若冥刃能永久消弭这一威胁……我只能盼望艾斯妮能原谅我。”

english: Lucian loosed his men to ravage Torrolerial. The battle had been hard fought and they had earned their reward. He followed Auric into the cathedral flanked by Illian captains who cut down the remaining priests defending the building.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The walls were covered in scenes of the Bannor's battles in hell. In each Sabathiel or Capria stood protectively over the loyal soldiers. In one a single Bannor soldier stood before a closing portal with a host of demons around him.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]At the center of cathedral was a chamber covered with the symbols of Junil. A door set with a blazing sword was the only way into the chamber and the laws to enter were inscribed on it. It claimed that the area beyond was between this world and heaven, that it was sanctified ground and that only the high priests could open or pass through the door.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Auric ignored the warnings and threw the door open. Lucian readied his axe; he didn't know what to expect from an archangel but his axe hadn't failed him yet.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But the chamber beyond was empty. There was only dust inside, no one had entered the chamber for years.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Has Sabathiel fled?" one of the captains asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No." Despite his frustration Auric smiled. "The priests have been lying to the people. They claim that their laws are passed down from the archangel that protected them in hell but he abandoned them long ago. But they continue to use his legend to control the Bannor. This lie has cost them their capital."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"And what of our ritual?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"It seems we have another debt to repay. Sabathiel is not the only archangel in Erebus-there is one within the Grigori lands as well."
chinese: 卢西恩放手让部下劫掠托罗勒里尔。这场战斗打得艰苦，他们已赢得了自己的犒赏。他随奥里克进入大教堂，两侧是伊利安的队长们，他们斩杀了残余的守卫这座建筑的祭司。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]墙壁上满是班诺尔人在地狱中征战的景象。每一幅中，萨巴曦尔或凯布瑞尔都护卫般地站在忠诚的士兵之上。其中一幅里，一名孤身的班诺尔士兵立于一道正在闭合的传送门前，周身环绕着一群恶魔。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]大教堂的中央是一间满布尤尼尔符号的密室。一扇镶着熊熊燃剑的门是进入密室的唯一途径，入内的律法就刻在门上。它宣称门后的区域介于此世与天堂之间，是圣化之地，唯有高阶祭司方可开启此门或从中通过。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥里克无视那些警告，猛地推开了门。卢西恩握紧了斧子；他不知该对一位大天使抱何期待，但他的斧子至今尚未辜负过他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]然而门后的密室空空如也。里头只有尘埃，多年来无人踏入过这间密室。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“萨巴曦尔逃了？”一名队长问道。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“不。”尽管沮丧，奥里克却笑了。“祭司们一直在欺瞒民众。他们宣称自己的律法是那位在地狱中庇护他们的大天使传下的，可他早已弃他们而去。但他们仍旧借他的传说来操控班诺尔人。这个谎言让他们丢了自己的都城。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“那我们的仪式又该如何？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“看来我们还有一笔债要还。萨巴曦尔并非埃瑞布斯唯一的大天使——格利高里的疆域内也有一位。”

english: Decius wipes the goblin blood from his sword and without pause begins the next task-razing the fort the goblins were using to launch attacks at the Bannor outpost. He is soon interrupted by a messenger. "Decius Achare, you are requested by the Lady Commanders." Decius nods and sets his men to tearing down the goblin fortifications.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Decius, I am sending you back to Torrolerial."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes milady. May I speak freely?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Of course."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Why send a man of action back to the capital? This seems a demotion to me."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Capria smiles. "No, it is not a demotion nor is it my decision. The Diviner claims it is of great importance that you do so, or all of the Empire is imperiled. So go at once and report to your father." Decius turned to gather supplies, and was riding homeward within the hour.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius entered the meeting hall of House Achare's stronghold. "I have come, Lord Commander, though I know not why. Lady Capria had good use of me in the front."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lord Samatheon replied, "We are off the field, my son, you can drop my title. Your name has gained some renown, and I would grant you your command. Though you are right to suspect that I would leave you to Lady Capria until the completion of her campaign if I could. While the Diviners are as forthcoming as usual, they must be heeded, and they have expressed grave concerns about supernatural threats in this region. Since your brother has taken his command south to reinforce the Labuscrum, I need a commander I can trust for House Achare's legions. I place you in command of our expeditionary force; unfortunately you will be need an 'advisor.'"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I thank you for your trust, father, I shall do you proud."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"As the priests say, first to your god, then to your king, then to your commander. Go therefore to the Abbey of Brigit's Light, then to the duties they have for our forces. Return home when you can, for I would like much to hear news of your travels. Dismissed."
chinese: 德西乌斯拭去剑上的哥布林之血，未作停顿便着手下一项任务——夷平哥布林用来对班诺尔前哨发动进攻的那座堡垒。不多时，一名信使打断了他。“德西乌斯·阿卡雷，女指挥官们召见你。”德西乌斯点点头，吩咐部下拆毁哥布林的工事。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“德西乌斯，我要派你回托罗勒里尔。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“遵命，夫人。我可否直言？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“当然。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“为何要把一个行动之人调回都城？在我看来这像是降职。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]凯布瑞尔微微一笑。“不，这既非降职，也非我的决定。占卜者称此事关系重大，你若不去，整个帝国都将陷入险境。所以立刻动身，去向你父亲复命。”德西乌斯转身去备办给养，不出一个时辰便已策马归乡。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯步入阿卡雷家族要塞的议事厅。“我来了，指挥官大人，虽然我并不知为何。凯布瑞尔夫人在前线本可好好用我。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]萨玛西恩大人答道：“我们已离了战场，我的孩子，你可以省去我的头衔。你的名字已小有声望，我打算授你以指挥之权。不过你猜得没错，若可以，我本愿把你留给凯布瑞尔夫人，直到她的战役完结。占卜者们一如既往地语焉不详，却不可不听，而他们已对这一地区超自然的威胁表达了严重的忧虑。既然你兄长已率部南下增援拉布斯克鲁姆，我便需要一个我能信任的指挥官来统领阿卡雷家族的军团。我任命你统领我们的远征军；只可惜你会需要一位‘顾问’。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“感谢您的信任，父亲，我定不辱使命。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“正如祭司们所言，先敬你的神，再敬你的王，然后才是你的指挥官。因此先去布里吉特之光修道院，再去履行他们为我们的军队安排的职责。得空便归家，我很想听听你旅途的消息。退下吧。”

english: Your confessor approaches you as you prepare your army to move. "Commander Decius, we have uncovered the source of the taint we discovered in the jungles. In fact, it stems from the ports of the Lanun. We had negotiated trade relations with the Lanun, but apparently they have allowed their cities to be infested by the Undertow. We must wipe out every city with the Undertow religion."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rosier says "So you only freed the twisted men in order to track them down and destroy them?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"If these people have given their souls to demons, their lives are forfeit. If their Oaths hold true, they shall dwell with Junil forever. Either way we shall protect the Bannor from this taint, and the power of the good shall not fade nor flicker from the face of Erebus."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"This seems less of good than of power to me, Decius." says Rosier.
chinese: 你正整备军队准备开拔，你的忏悔祭司走上前来。“德西乌斯指挥官，我们已查明在丛林中发现的那股污秽之源。事实上，它源自拉努恩的港口。我们本已与拉努恩谈妥了贸易关系，但显然他们任由自己的城市被‘暗流’侵蚀。我们必须荡平每一座信奉暗流教的城市。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]罗希尔说：“这么说，你解放那些扭曲之人，只是为了追踪并铲除他们？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“若这些人已把灵魂交给了恶魔，他们的性命便已注定。若他们的誓言仍属真实，他们将永与尤尼尔同在。无论哪种结局，我们都将保护班诺尔免受这股污秽的侵害，善之力量绝不会从埃瑞布斯的大地上消退或摇曳。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“在我看来，这更关乎权力而非善行，德西乌斯。”罗希尔说。

english: A Speaker is brought before you as you watch the destruction of the Lanun's Temple of the Undertow. "Your trespass here is unforgivable! This sacred ground rings with echoes of the depths."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Your allegiance to evil has sealed your fate," Wallon says.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Fate is ours to twist, and vengeance mine to take. Rise, servants!"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius scans the horizon, then shouts to his advisors, "Look to the horizon! Drown rise from the depths and head for Cuantine. We cannot get there before them on foot."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rosier says "The artifacts of these cultists, I have seen them used to travel over the water."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We cannot risk the taint these bear," the Confessor tells him.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Foolish priest, it is worth the risk. You gamble the lives of our people for your purity's sake? You follow your law, then, and I will follow my own heart." Rosier dons the mask of the Speaker, and heads towards the waves.
chinese: 你注视着拉努恩暗流神庙被摧毁，一名传谕者被押到你面前。“你在此地的擅闯不可饶恕！这片圣土回荡着深渊的回响。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你对邪恶的效忠已注定了你的命运，”沃伦说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“命运由我们扭转，复仇归我索取。起来吧，仆从们！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯扫视着地平线，随即向他的顾问们高喊：“看向地平线！溺死者正从深处升起，直奔库安汀。我们徒步无法赶在他们之前抵达。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]罗希尔说：“这些邪教徒的神器，我曾见人用它们在水面上行进。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们不能冒这些东西所带污秽的险，”忏悔祭司对他说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“愚蠢的祭司，这险值得一冒。你竟为你那份纯净，拿我们子民的性命做赌注？那你就守你的律法吧，我则遵从我自己的本心。”罗希尔戴上传谕者的面具，朝波涛走去。

english: Description: Dain means to pass the trials of the Cave of Ancestors.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Special Rules: This is a dungeon adventure. You control one unit through the challenges of the scenario and if that unit dies you lose.
chinese: 描述：丹安意欲通过先祖之洞的试炼。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则：这是一场地下城冒险。你操控一个单位闯过剧本的重重挑战，若该单位死亡，你便告败。

english: During the Age of Magic Kylorin used magical trials to separate common mages from the truly talented. The things that appeared in the trials were illusions, but the risk of death was real. Most died, but the few that passed the trials went on to be some of the most powerful archmages of their age.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Some or the leaders in the current age, such as Os-Gabella and Perpentach, went through these trials when Patria was still the only empire of man. Others, such as Laroth, Barbatos or Trenton Majosi are less well known survivors of the trials.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It was hundreds of years into the Age of Rebirth before Dain of the Amurites, discovered the records of these magical trials. They were considered archaic, a violent reminder of Patria during its darkest hours. The culture of the Amurites celebrated public study of magic and this was seen as a more enlightened approach.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But Dain wondered how he compared to the Patrian archmages. And was even more interested in the greater talent the trial seemed to imbue in the lucky few who survived. Dain searched for, and found several locations for these trials, but most were simply empty towers, dungeons or cave labyrinths. Until in the year 441 of the fourth age Dain found the location of one that was still active.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The locals, a group of Balseraph fishermen living on the edge of their empire, long ago learned to avoid the cave; no one who entered it ever came out. They claimed death himself lived within it. They also claimed that chickens were divine, so Dain didn't take their warnings very seriously.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]With a spellstaff and healing salve ready, as these were the traditional aides given to those taking the trial, Dain entered the cave.
chinese: 在魔法纪元，凯洛林以魔法试炼将寻常法师同真正的天才区分开来。试炼中出现的一切皆是幻象，但死亡的风险却是真实的。多数人殒命，而少数通过试炼者，则成为了他们那个时代最强大的一批大魔法师。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当代的一些领袖，如奥斯·加贝拉和普宾塔克，是在帕特里亚尚为人类唯一帝国之时经历这些试炼的。另一些人，如拉罗斯、巴巴托斯或特伦顿·马乔西，则是不那么为人所知的试炼幸存者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]直到重生纪元过去数百年之后，阿姆莱特的丹安才发现了这些魔法试炼的记录。它们被视为陈腐之物，是帕特里亚最黑暗时期的暴力遗迹。阿姆莱特的文化崇尚公开研习魔法，此举被看作一种更为开明的途径。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]但丹安好奇自己与那些帕特里亚大魔法师相比究竟如何。他更感兴趣的，是这试炼似乎赋予那少数幸运幸存者的更强天赋。丹安四处寻访，找到了这些试炼的数处所在，但大多不过是空荡荡的塔楼、地牢或洞穴迷宫。直到第四纪元441年，丹安才找到了一处仍在运转的所在。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当地人是一群住在其帝国边陲的巴尔塞拉弗渔民，很久以前便学会了避开那座洞穴；凡入内者，无一生还。他们声称死神本人就住在里头。他们还声称鸡是神圣的，所以丹安并未把他们的警告太当回事。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]备好法杖与愈伤药膏——这些是给接受试炼者的传统辅助之物——丹安走进了那座洞穴。

english: Decius has fled his homeland after being charged with witchcraft and conjuring demons. He seeks to preserve his values and find a new beginning among the Malakim, across the seas in the desert of Myrh. This ancient tribal people is coalescing around an unlikely new spiritual leader-the elf Varn Gosam, a refugee from an isolated elven community.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Malakim have taken in Decius and his entourage; hospitality in the desert is an iron law. He has yet to see meet his host, however.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]While watching the young soldiers drill in the evening Decius is approached by a raven-haired woman flanked by a sand lion cub. Flowing robes keep the sun off her skin but do nothing to hide her figure as the wind blows them taut against her. "Welcome, stranger. You have the look of one who well knows the art these boys struggle to master."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I was a soldier of some renown, milady, and a commander for a season. I felled my people's enemies, until I was deemed one."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Strong and wise, and bereft of your heritage, like our Varn. We could make use of your skills, in exchange for a place of refuge."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"A gracious offer, milady. Have you the authority to make it?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"It is not authority I wield here, just influence, but I suspect it will be enough. More so if you could perform one task for us now. Varn Gosam has been gone for some time on pilgrimage, too long I fear. Lead a party to find him, east at the Mirror of Heaven, and you will have proven your worth and earned your place."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius rises with a nod. "I shall do so then. Who shall I say has commissioned this search?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The lady smiles. "My name is Talia."
chinese: 德西乌斯因被指控行使巫术、召唤恶魔而逃离了家园。他意图守住自己的信念，并在马拉基姆人之中寻得新的开端——那是在海的另一端、米尔沙漠里。这支古老的部族正围绕一位出人意料的新精神领袖凝聚起来——精灵范恩·哥萨姆，一个来自与世隔绝的精灵社群的难民。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]马拉基姆人收留了德西乌斯及其随从；在沙漠中，好客是铁一般的律法。然而他还未见过自己的东道主。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]傍晚，德西乌斯正看着年轻士兵操练，一名乌黑长发的女子朝他走来，身旁伴着一头沙狮幼崽。飘逸的长袍替她的肌肤挡去烈日，却在风将其吹得紧贴身躯时，丝毫遮不住她的身形。“欢迎，异乡人。你看上去像是深谙这些孩子苦苦想要掌握的技艺之人。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我曾是个小有名气的士兵，夫人，也做过一阵子指挥官。我斩杀我族人的敌人，直到我自己被视为敌人。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“强壮而睿智，又如我们的范恩一般被剥夺了故土。我们能用得上你的本领，作为交换，给你一处庇护之所。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“慷慨的提议，夫人。您可有作此提议的权柄？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我在此地掌握的并非权柄，只是影响力，但我料想这已足够。倘若你眼下能为我们办成一件事，便更是如此。范恩·哥萨姆已外出朝圣有些时日了，我担心，太久了。带一队人去寻他，往东，到天镜之处，你便证明了自己的价值，赢得了你的一席之地。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯颔首起身。“那我便去做。我该说是谁委派了这次搜寻？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]那位女子微微一笑。“我叫塔利亚。”

english: This altar is for the Lord of the Balors. The vast minions of hell sacrifice here in the hope of gaining some favor with Hyborem. Many generals have made it this far, but you are the first that wasn't carried here by demonic legions and sacrificed on the black and red stone.
chinese: 这座祭坛属于巨角炎魔之主。地狱庞大的爪牙在此献祭，盼能博得海勃雷姆几分青睐。许多将领曾走到这一步，但你是头一个不是被恶魔军团抬到此处、在这黑红二色的石上被献祭的人。

english: The Mercurian men cheered. These were fierce, passionate men who viewed their lives as a temporary stage before their transform into the magnificent angels of Basium's army. They threw themselves fully into battle and marched unquestioning into the Fane of Lessers. Death in righteous battle was their hope. There was no such thing as an old Mercurian soldier.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The angels were more somber. The Seraphim with their blazing swords kept careful watch for more dangers, the Ophanim floated above the broken fields for the first time riding unhindered within the Fane and the Valkyries tended to the dead.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basium stood before the Throne of Hell, a vast gaping hole in Erebus. The ground around it bled a thick, dark ichor. It was a physical wound in this world, fully contaminated and defiled. Through it hell could be seen, a vast mountain sloping ever down to dark swamps. Somewhere beyond that swamp Basium knew the foul city of Mammon sat. It was the first step in turning the souls of men into demons.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basium raised his club, within it demons howled in pain and torment, for it wouldn't let any demon it killed return to their immortal realms. Two Seraphim settled beside the portal, swords drawn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Factum est." the Seraphim intoned.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Not yet" Basium replied, "our battle is not done. If we mean to truly defeat the Infernal we must tear down the city of Mammon, march across the fields of Camulos and destroy the temples of Aeron. Then we will rouse Agares himself, send an army into the dust sea and remove him from his dominion."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]With that Basium marched through the gate and his army marched unquestioningly after him. After they had all passed through they destroyed the gate behind them. An entire army, a nation, walked willingly into hell and disappeared from Erebus.
chinese: 天界的将士们欢呼起来。这些人凶悍而充满热忱，把自己的生命看作蜕变为巴希姆军中那壮丽天使之前的一段暂时阶段。他们全身心投入战斗，义无反顾地开进贱者之殿。在正义之战中牺牲便是他们的期盼。天界之中，从没有年老的士兵这回事。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]天使们则更为肃穆。持着炽燃之剑的炽天使警惕地守望着更多危险，座天使头一回在殿内畅行无阻地飘浮于破碎的战场之上，瓦尔基里则照料着亡者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]巴希姆立于地狱王座之前——那是埃瑞布斯上一道巨大而张开的裂口。周围的土地渗出浓稠而暗黑的脓液。这是这世界上一道实实在在的伤口，彻底被玷污、被亵渎。透过它可以望见地狱，一座巨大的山峦不断向下倾斜，直入幽暗的沼泽。巴希姆知道，在那沼泽之外的某处，坐落着玛门那座污秽之城。那是将人的灵魂化为恶魔的第一步。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]巴希姆举起他的巨棒，棒中恶魔在痛苦与折磨中嚎叫，因为它绝不让任何被它所杀的恶魔返回其不朽之境。两名炽天使在传送门旁列定，拔剑在手。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“Factum est。”炽天使低声诵念。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“还没有，”巴希姆答道，“我们的战斗尚未结束。若我们当真要击败地狱军团，就必须夷平玛门之城，横越卡穆洛斯的原野，摧毁艾隆的神庙。然后我们将唤起阿加雷斯本尊，派一支军队开进尘海，把他逐出他的领地。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]言罢，巴希姆迈步穿过大门，他的军队毫不迟疑地跟随其后。待众人尽数通过，他们便将身后的大门摧毁。一整支军队，一个民族，自愿走入地狱，从埃瑞布斯上消失了。

english: The souls hiding in this pass are cowards hiding from their demonic lords. At first they mistook Keelyn for a succubus queen and fled. Keelyn, curious to see what these timid shapes bounding away in terror are, ordered a few of them captured. Upon capture, one of the souls struggled for words.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Your malevolence," he began, "we are of no interest to you... let us be, we are unworthy."[PARAGRAPH:1]"I will," Keelyn responded, "if you agree to be good little spirits and serve me."[PARAGRAPH:1]"We have always served you and your masters, lady..." one of the souls stammered.[PARAGRAPH:1]Keelyn took out a runic knife and sliced the spirit, which screamed in pain.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I don't have a master," Keelyn said, "and soon these lands will be mine. I don't have to follow anyone's rules."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Very well, than we kneel before you... as... the new Queen of the Fane of the Lessers, glorious mistress of..." another slice, another scream of pain.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I prefer Princess of the Fane. Queens are old and tired, princesses are young and pretty. And forget the Lessers, it doesn't sound very impressive."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Yes, yes... whatever you wish... you are the Princess of the Fane, your beauty is beyond words, your power is beyond our mere comprehension, just please don't hurt us."[PARAGRAPH:1]"I won't, if you do one thing."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Why, anything, your grace!"[PARAGRAPH:1]"I'm bored. Sing me a song." With a casual spin of a dagger, she adds, "and make sure it's a good one."
chinese: 躲藏在这处隘口的灵魂，是些躲避其恶魔主宰的懦夫。起初他们把琪琳错认成了魅魔女王，纷纷逃窜。琪琳好奇这些惊恐蹦跳着逃开的怯懦身影究竟是什么，便下令捉住其中几个。被擒之后，其中一个灵魂结结巴巴地想要开口。[PARAGRAPH:1]“您的恶毒殿下，”他起头道，“我们对您毫无价值……放过我们吧，我们不配。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“可以，”琪琳回应道，“只要你们答应做乖巧的小灵魂，侍奉我。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我们一向侍奉您和您的主人们，夫人……”一个灵魂支吾道。[PARAGRAPH:1]琪琳掏出一把符文小刀，划向那灵魂，它痛得尖叫起来。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我可没有主人，”琪琳说，“而且这片土地不久就将归我所有。我用不着遵从任何人的规矩。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“好，好，那我们便跪伏于您……作为……贱者之殿的新女王，光辉的女主……”又一划，又一声痛苦的尖叫。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我更喜欢殿之公主。女王又老又累，公主既年轻又漂亮。还有，把‘贱者’去掉，听着一点也不气派。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“是，是……悉听尊便……您是殿之公主，您的美貌无以言表，您的力量非我们区区所能理解，只求您别伤害我们。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我不会，只要你们做一件事。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“哎呀，什么都行，殿下！”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我无聊了。给我唱首歌。”她漫不经心地转了转匕首，又补上一句，“记得，得是首好的。”

english: The Illians' homeland has been reclaimed. The Illian elders are grateful for your help and they listen intently to your story of the prophecy. Together you set out to the site of Mulcarn's death, the ruins of Letum Frigus. You arrive just as Illian man walks out of the ruins. He is barely covered but unaffected by the freezing temperature.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I am the one you seek, Auric Ulvin, the reborn form of the god of winter. Follow me and this world will belong to us again."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Around you men drop to their knees in worship, Doviello and Illian alike. Could this young man be the god you seek?
chinese: 伊利安人的家园已被夺回。伊利安的长老们感激你的相助，专注地听着你讲述那则预言。你们一同启程，前往穆卡恩殒命之地——莱图姆·弗里古斯的废墟。你们抵达时，恰有一名伊利安男子从废墟中走出。他几近赤身，却丝毫不受严寒影响。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我便是你所寻之人，奥里克·尤尔文，寒冬之神的重生之身。追随我，这世界将再度属于我们。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]你周围的人纷纷屈膝跪拜，多维洛人与伊利安人皆然。这个年轻人，会是你所寻的那位神吗？

english: Rhoanna lay tangled in the sheets. She was as beautiful and fierce as any woman, and a lifetime spent in the saddle had turned last night's passion into an athletic event. Falamar had always felt himself a more than adequate, some had said legendary, lover but Rhoanna was insatiable. Falamar slipped quietly from the bed in the fear that if she awoke she would not let him escape. He felt sudden sympathy for the wild mustangs Rhoanna had ridden until they broke and surrendered to her will.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Up on deck the sea air revived him and he stretched and called for a report from Amergin, and a hot tea from a deck hand.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No rum captain?" the deck hand asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"My body aches enough this morning Rory, best to at least keep my mind sharp." Falamar answered, then turning to Amergin he said, "How close are we to the Dead Lands?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We will be upon them by midday. There are already reports that the Sheaim are readying for us, and our advance ship returned during the night crewed by skeletons. We had to sink it ourselves."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar's eyes widened and he called down to Rory in the mess, "on second thought I'll take a bit of rum with that, on the side." Looking back at Amergin he asked, "Anything else?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The Dead Lands appear much as our own except at its heart where it's as defiled as Hyborem's own lands. Tebryn has a spell around these lands that keeps anyone from entering without his approval. This spell is maintained by ritualists in the capital of his generals, Averax, Gosea and Malchavic. Until they are destroyed we won't be able to assault Tebryn directly."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rory placed the hot tea and rum at Falamar's side and asked, "Anything else captain?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No, thank you Rory." Falamar quickly drank the rum before asking Amergin to continue.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"There are reports that men who die within this region find their souls drawn to the black tower, where they are transformed into hellish versions of themselves, skeletons, wraiths, sect of flies, eidolons and such. I cannot imagine a worse fate for a man's soul, and for us it means that we will face any we lose in battle."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I'm going to need more rum!" Falamar yelled to Rory, who quickly scrambled to refill Falamar's goblet.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Anything else Amergin?" Falamar asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The living seem unable to heal here. Those injured in the battle against the skeleton ship still bleed as if their wounds were fresh. These lands are cursed, and it does not favor us."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Falamar downed the second rum, "And what of the rum?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We are well stocked captain."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Lock away my enemy in an unassailable location, subject me to the threat of eternal damnation as some wretched bone pile, remove from me even the tiny gifts of health and healing, but leave the rum."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Aye captain." Amergin grinned, a rare sight on the first mate.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You had best rouse our guest and tell her everything you have told me. We will need all the strength we have by midday."
chinese: 罗安娜缠裹在床单之中。她如任何女子一般美丽而凶悍，一生在马鞍上度过，把昨夜的激情变成了一场体力较量。法拉玛向来自认是个不止于称职、甚而有人称之为传奇的情人，可罗安娜却贪得无厌。法拉玛悄悄溜下床，生怕她一旦醒来便不肯放他脱身。他忽然对那些被罗安娜骑到力竭、屈服于她意志的野马生出几分同情。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]甲板上的海风令他重新振作，他伸了个懒腰，唤阿默金来禀报军情，又让一名甲板水手送来一杯热茶。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“不来点朗姆酒吗，船长？”那水手问。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“今早我这身子骨已经够酸痛了，罗里，至少还是让脑子清醒着为好。”法拉玛答道，随即转向阿默金说，“我们离亡者之地还有多远？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“正午前便会抵达。已有消息说塞安人正严阵以待，我们的先遣船昨夜返航时，船上尽是骷髅。我们只得亲手将它凿沉。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]法拉玛瞪大了眼，向下冲着膳舱里的罗里喊：“再想想，那茶里还是给我配点朗姆酒吧，另盛一杯。”他回头看向阿默金，问道，“还有别的吗？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“亡者之地看上去与我们自己的土地大致无异，唯有其腹地例外，那里被玷污得如同海勃雷姆本人的领地。特布里恩在这片土地周围布下一道法术，让任何人未经他允许都无法进入。这道法术由驻在他麾下将领——爱华拉克斯、高希和马加别克——都城中的法阵祭司维持。除非将他们铲除，否则我们无法直接进攻特布里恩。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]罗里把热茶和朗姆酒搁到法拉玛身旁，问道：“还有别的吗，船长？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“没了，谢谢你，罗里。”法拉玛飞快地把朗姆酒一饮而尽，才让阿默金接着说下去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“有消息说，在这一带殒命之人，其灵魂会被拽向那座黑塔，在那里被扭曲成地狱般的模样——骷髅、厉鬼、蝇群、幻影死灵之类。我想不出比这更凄惨的下场了，而对我们而言，这意味着我们将在战场上面对任何一个我们失去的同伴。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我需要更多朗姆酒！”法拉玛冲罗里嚷道，罗里赶忙手忙脚乱地给法拉玛的酒杯续满。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“还有别的吗，阿默金？”法拉玛问。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“活人在此地似乎无法痊愈。那些在对抗骷髅船的战斗中受伤的人，伤口仍像新添的一般淌血。这片土地被诅咒了，而这诅咒对我们不利。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]法拉玛把第二杯朗姆酒也灌了下去，“那朗姆酒又如何？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“存货充足，船长。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“把我的敌人锁在一处无从攻取的所在，让我面临沦为某堆可怜白骨、永受诅咒的威胁，甚至连健康与疗愈这点微末的恩赐都从我身上夺走，可总算给我留下了朗姆酒。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“是，船长。”阿默金咧嘴一笑，这在这位大副脸上难得一见。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你最好去唤醒我们的客人，把你告诉我的一切都对她说一遍。正午前，我们会用得上我们所有的力量。”

english: I've fallen so far from my home and I'm cursed to be buried in these crazed lands. I would have done better to fall on the horseman's spear than in his cage.
chinese: 我已离家如此遥远，注定要葬身于这些疯癫之地。我倒不如死在骑手的长矛下，也强过死在他的牢笼里。

english: Falamar.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There was nothing but darkness.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Falamar."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I twisted in my dreams. I still imagined the tentacle around my leg through the veil of fear and emptiness. I drifted toward eternal sleep, but something wouldn't let me go.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Falamar."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I opened my eyes and there was water all around, a world without earth or sky. I floated weightless in the current, forever falling in the seas caress.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There was another above me, a woman, but as inhuman as she was beautiful. She was the tide, powerful but yielding, fleeting but eternal.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Who are you?" I asked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I am Condatis, the archangel of Danalin, God of the Sea."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Afraid, I tried to swim away from her. I wasn't religious but I had seen enough temples and asylums of those that worshiped Danalin to suspect that this wasn't the afterlife I intended. Even if it did feature floating billowy maidens.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Danalin? As in the Undertow? Is this the heaven for cultists and zealots?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]She looked hurt. There was pain in her eyes, and love. I regretted my words.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No." she replied.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Oh... are you my reward?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"No!" she said, this time there was anger in her eyes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I seemed to be getting this all wrong so I just floated silently and let her speak.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I led you to Keelyn so that she would take you to her father, but Hastur predicts my actions. An archmage, Tebryn Arbandi, means to destroy creation. Go to the Momus, convince him to supply you with a fleet then sail through the Arduro Straight to the Dead Lands. Defeat Tebryn so I have time to defeat Hastur."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You sure you don't want Capria, or that guy that killed Mulcarn? I'm more of a steal-the-king's-galleon kind of hero."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]She smiled, "My young prince, we must all make do with what we have."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The water rippled and her face was replaced with the bearded face of Amergin. He was pulling me up on the beach.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Falamar, are you okay?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I'm okay," I stammered through racking coughs, "how are the men?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Some are fine, others haven't been recovered yet."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]I understood his meaning and picked myself up. After recovering far too few of my men from the sea we went to meet with Perpentach. He ignored the threat of Tebryn and my pleas for help. But he was holding a competition between warlords, and he promised to supply the navy I required if I won. With few men and no ships, we had little choice but to enter.
chinese: 法拉玛。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]四下唯有黑暗。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法拉玛。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我在梦中辗转。透过恐惧与虚空的帷幕，我仍想象着那缠在我腿上的触须。我朝着永眠漂去，却有什么不肯放我离去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法拉玛。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我睁开眼，四周尽是海水，一个没有大地也没有天空的世界。我在水流中失重地漂浮，永远坠落于大海的爱抚里。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我上方还有一人，一名女子，她既非人类般美丽，又非人类。她就是潮汐，强大却柔顺，短暂却永恒。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你是谁？”我问。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我是孔达提斯，海神达纳林的大天使。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我害怕起来，试图从她身边游开。我并不信教，但我见过够多崇拜达纳林之人的神庙与疯人院，足以怀疑这并非我所盼的来世。哪怕它当真有飘浮的、丰盈的少女。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“达纳林？就是那个‘暗流’？这是给邪教徒和狂信者的天堂吗？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她看上去很受伤。她眼中有痛楚，也有爱意。我后悔说了那些话。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“不是。”她答道。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“哦……那你是我的犒赏？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“不是！”她说，这一次她眼中有了怒意。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我似乎全都会错了意，于是只静静漂着，任她说下去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我引你去见琪琳，好让她带你去见她的父亲，可哈斯图尔预知了我的举动。一位大魔法师，特布里恩·阿尔班第，意欲毁灭造物。去找莫姆斯，说服他为你提供一支舰队，然后穿过阿尔杜罗海峡驶向亡者之地。击败特布里恩，好让我有时间击败哈斯图尔。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你确定不要凯布瑞尔，或者那个杀了穆卡恩的家伙？我更像是那种偷走国王大帆船的英雄。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]她笑了，“我年轻的王子，我们都得将就着用手头所有的东西。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]水面泛起涟漪，她的面容被阿默金那张长着胡须的脸取代。他正把我拖上沙滩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法拉玛，你没事吧？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我没事，”我在一阵剧烈的咳嗽中结结巴巴地说，“弟兄们怎么样了？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“有些无恙，另一些还没找回来。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我明白了他的意思，撑起身子。从海里找回的部下少得可怜之后，我们前去与普宾塔克会面。他无视特布里恩的威胁，也无视我求助的恳请。但他正在诸位军阀之间举办一场比试，并许诺，我若获胜，便供我所需的舰队。手中兵少、又无船只，我们别无多少选择，只得参赛。

english: Faeryl was laid to rest with the honors due an elven queen. Though many argued against a funeral for an enemy leader, Arendel had demanded it. As controversial as it had been no one questioned it now and the massive funeral was properly somber and respectful.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Of the former Svartalfar, all those that had sworn allegiance to the summer court were invited to attend. For the first time in two ages the Svartalfar and Ljosalfar united in a common task, even if it was to mourn the death of the winter queen. They stood up and eulogized her and Svartalfar and Ljosalfar alike shed tears for Faeryl. Even Arendel stood and spoke lovingly of her sister, the fallen queen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]That night the funeral procession passed through the streets of Evermore as starlight glistened off of the silver and mithril coffin. As was tradition her coffin was displayed within the Sacred Grove for the night and then moved to the hidden tomb used to house elven royalty in the morning. By then thousands of gifts were brought to the temple and laid around the tomb.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Just before dawn horns summoned all the citizens of Evermore to the city's grand plaza. Once everyone was gathered Arendel came out onto the palace balcony and addressed them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We must not forget. We must not forget our legends, the days spent within this very wood as the children of Sucellus and Cernunnos. We must not forget that age we spent on our own as a single elven nation and the trials and fortune we shared. And we must not forget that we turned to war with each other."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Every memory we have is shared, every glory, every defeat. We are one people, and we were even as we killed each other."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Long ago, Sucellus anointed two queens to lead us so that the passions of one person could not lead our empire into ruin as happened with the empire of men. But this split led to civil war."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Through prayer and careful deliberation with the priests, sages and captains of both former empires we have decided to form a new high council. That there would be two elven queens and an elven king to lead us. That these leaders would rule year round within their own nations and that they would come together to decide matters for the empire."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I will be the queen of Evermore, of the temples and over the monuments and artifacts of our empire. I will tend to the orchards and provide for the musicians, artists and craftsmen. Brave Amelanchier will be anointed as king and assigned our army, given provision over our forts and made responsible for our defense. He will also take charge of our hunters and be responsible for the lands untended within our borders. Thessa will be anointed as queen and responsible for all manners of study, arcane or mundane, as well as diplomacy and trade with other lands. If military action is to occur outside of our empire then it will be under her leadership."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"If you are a child of Sucellus then you are a member of our empire. A particular faith is not a requirement and the former Svartalfar are equal in every way to other citizens. The war is over and if we are to shed tears then we must do so together. If we are angry then we must be angry with ourselves. As mighty Sucellus was destroyed by winter and split apart until Nantosuelta gathered his pieces back together for his resurrection, so are the Ljosalfar. Now rejoined we are reborn, and I pray that will ever be so."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]As dawn struck the plaza the Ljosalfar palace seemed to glow with an aura of gold and white. It was a new world for the Ljosalfar and they couldn't help but feel hopeful that it would be a kinder world than they had known for centuries.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]That night, after to coronation of Thessa and Amelanchier and seeing them off to their remote capitals Arendel retired to her personal chambers. After checking the magical wards that protected the rooms she removed her amulet and watched in the mirror as the illusion melted away. Her long blond hair shortened to wavy black. Her skin paled to cool alabaster. Her body shifted from the lean beautiful form of the elven queen to her own more sensual and curved body.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Far away, beneath the great red oak of Evermore, within the hidden tomb for elven royalty, behind powerful guards and locked within a silver and mithril box the real Arendel screamed.
chinese: 菲尔蕾尔以配得上一位精灵女王的荣誉入土安葬。尽管许多人反对为一位敌方领袖举行葬礼，阿伦德尔却坚持如此。事情虽曾引起争议，如今却无人质疑，这场盛大的葬礼庄重而肃穆，充满敬意。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]昔日的斯瓦塔尔法之中，凡宣誓效忠夏之宫廷者，都受邀出席。两个纪元以来，斯瓦塔尔法与勒约沙尔法头一回为了一桩共同之事而联合，哪怕那只是为哀悼冬之女王之死。他们起身为她致悼词，斯瓦塔尔法与勒约沙尔法都为菲尔蕾尔洒下泪水。就连阿伦德尔也起身，深情地追念她的姐妹，那位陨落的女王。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]那一夜，送葬的队伍穿过永恒之城的街道，星光在银与秘银铸就的棺椁上闪烁。依照传统，她的棺椁在圣林中陈放一夜，翌晨移入安葬精灵王族的隐秘陵墓。到那时，已有成千上万的祭礼被送到神庙，环绕在陵墓四周。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]黎明将至，号角召集永恒之城的全体市民到城中的大广场。众人聚齐之后，阿伦德尔走上宫殿的阳台，向他们致辞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们绝不能忘记。绝不能忘记我们的传说，忘记我们身为苏切鲁斯与凯尔努诺斯之子、在这片森林中度过的岁月。绝不能忘记我们作为一个单一精灵民族独自度过的那个纪元，忘记我们共担的磨难与共享的幸运。我们更绝不能忘记，我们曾兵戈相向，自相残杀。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们所拥有的每一段记忆都是共有的，每一份荣耀，每一场败绩。我们是同一个民族，哪怕在我们彼此厮杀之时也是如此。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“很久以前，苏切鲁斯册立两位女王来领导我们，好让一人的情感不至于像人类的帝国那样将我们的帝国拖入毁灭。可这一分立却引来了内战。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“通过祈祷，通过与两个昔日帝国的祭司、贤者与将领审慎商议，我们已决意组建一个新的高级议会。将有两位精灵女王与一位精灵国王来领导我们。这些领袖将常年治理各自的邦国，并聚到一处共决帝国之事。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我将作永恒之城的女王，掌管我们帝国的神庙、丰碑与神器。我将照料果园，供养乐师、艺术家与匠人。勇敢的阿米兰伽埃尔将受册立为王，统领我们的军队，掌管我们的堡垒，担起我们的防务之责。他还将统辖我们的猎人，负责我们疆界之内未经打理的土地。塞莎将受册立为女王，负责一切研习之事，无论奥法还是俗务，以及同他邦的外交与贸易。若要在我们帝国之外采取军事行动，那便由她来领导。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“只要你是苏切鲁斯之子，你便是我们帝国的一员。并不要求信奉某种特定的信仰，昔日的斯瓦塔尔法在一切方面都与其他市民平等无二。战争已经结束，我们若要落泪，便须一同落泪。我们若心怀愤怒，便须对我们自己愤怒。正如伟大的苏切鲁斯被寒冬摧毁、裂作碎片，直到南托苏埃尔塔将他的碎块重新聚合、使他复生，勒约沙尔法亦是如此。如今重归一体，我们便获得了重生，我愿祈祷此境长存。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]黎明照临广场之时，勒约沙尔法的宫殿仿佛焕发出金与白的光晕。这是勒约沙尔法的一个新世界，他们不禁满怀希望，盼这世界会比他们数百年来所熟知的更为仁厚。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]那一夜，在塞莎与阿米兰伽埃尔加冕、并目送他们前往各自偏远的都城之后，阿伦德尔退回了自己的私室。她查看过守护这些房间的魔法护咒，取下自己的护符，望着镜中幻象消融而去。她那头金色长发缩短，化作波浪般的黑发。她的肌肤褪成冷冽的雪花石白。她的身躯从那位精灵女王清瘦优美的形态，变回她自己那副更为妖娆、曲线毕露的身子。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在遥远之处，在永恒之城那株巨大红橡之下，在安葬精灵王族的隐秘陵墓之中，在森严的守卫之后，被锁在一具银与秘银铸就的匣子里，真正的阿伦德尔发出了尖叫。

english: Flauros had come to observe the progress Decius was making, and they consulted over dinner. Decius was eating the last stores of an elven city recently conquered, as it was getting harder to find decent food as Hyborem's corruption spread. Flauros merely sipped his imported wine. A fire crackled as they discussed the final battle plans, causing shadows to dance on the castle's walls.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]One of the shadows detached itself, however, and dove towards Decius, knives in each hand. One pierced the warrior's side, and he fell from his chair. Flauros watched calmly as Decius rolled aside and removed the knife. The wound wasn't bad, due to his light armor. The assassin lunged again, and Decius barely moved aside. He grabbed the man's arm and swung him into the wall, stunning him with a sickening crunch.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Flauros pushed himself back from the table and rose. "Very well done, my friend. With this invader as well as the entire Tempus Mor gambit. They say the best revenge is living well. I think you've earned the gift. Take this man's dying blood and I will show you the ritual we use to prolong our lives."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius gazed at the cloaked man for a moment, then drew his blade and plunged it into the assassin's heart. Flauros smiled, but Decius cut him off with a "No."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"You are refusing the gift?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Yes, I am. If I were to live forever, I might end up like you. Weak and soft."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]His patron replied by picking up the assassin and tearing his head off with his bare hands.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius continued, "You have physical strength, but you take it for granted. The cunning hunter has become the fat and lazy shepherd. Your immortality makes you content to sit back and let the world pass you by. I have walked alongside death and am not ready to abandon him now; I need this foe to keep my reflexes sharp and my plans focused."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Flauros studied Decius for a moment, then replied, "You no longer amuse me. I am returning to Prespur. You may do as you wish with those who will follow you, but do not return to my city on pain of death."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Decius watched Flauros left, then smiled to himself. He turned to the dead assassin and said, "Now, that's a useful trick you have. Wonder if there are any more like you?"
chinese: 弗劳诺斯前来查看德西乌斯的进展，两人边用晚膳边商议。德西乌斯正吃着一座新近被征服的精灵城市最后的存粮，因为随着海勃雷姆的腐化蔓延，像样的食物越来越难寻。弗劳诺斯只是啜饮着他的进口葡萄酒。他们商议着最终的战计，炉火噼啪作响，在城堡的墙上投下舞动的暗影。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]然而，其中一道暗影却脱离而出，双手各握一把匕首，朝德西乌斯扑来。一把刺入这武士的侧腹，他从椅上跌落。弗劳诺斯镇定地看着德西乌斯翻身滚开、拔出匕首。因他身着轻甲，伤势并不严重。刺客再度扑击，德西乌斯堪堪避开。他抓住那人的手臂，将他甩向墙壁，随着一声令人作呕的脆响将他撞得昏晕。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]弗劳诺斯从桌旁推身而起。“干得漂亮，我的朋友。无论是这名入侵者，还是整个坦普斯·摩尔的谋略。人们说，最好的复仇便是好好活着。我看你已挣得了这份馈赠。取这人临死之血，我便将我们用以延年益寿的仪式传授于你。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯凝视那披斗篷的男子片刻，随即拔刃刺入刺客的心脏。弗劳诺斯笑了，德西乌斯却以一声“不”打断了他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你在拒绝这份馈赠？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“是的，我拒绝。倘若我永生不死，我或许会落得跟你一样。软弱又懈怠。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]他的庇主以行动作答——一把提起那名刺客，赤手将他的头颅扯下。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯接着说：“你有一身蛮力，却把它视作理所当然。狡黠的猎手已变成了肥胖懒惰的牧人。你的不朽让你甘于安坐，任世界从你身旁流逝。我曾与死亡并肩而行，此刻还不打算抛下他；我需要这个敌人来使我的反应保持敏锐，使我的谋划保持专注。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]弗劳诺斯审视了德西乌斯片刻，随后答道：“你不再让我觉得有趣了。我要回普雷斯普了。你可以随意处置那些愿意追随你的人，但切莫再踏入我的城市，否则死路一条。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]德西乌斯看着弗劳诺斯离去，随即暗自一笑。他转向那具刺客的尸首，说道：“瞧，你这本事可真有用。不知还有没有别的像你这样的家伙？”

english: Decius directed his army to set up his camp on the foothills of Tempus Mor. The war had been long, and had hardened the Malakim recruits he led, but they stayed true to the Empyrean ideals, and had spared some remnant of his allies' civilizations. The eternal feud between Basium and the Infernals was sure to spread like fire to the rest of the world, as reports came in of Hellfire gates opening in distant lands through the actions of Sheaim agents.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But Tempus Mor would have peace, and Varn's vision of an alliance of the good nations had borne fruit. Decius set a guard and headed into his tent to plot his next action. After some time he fell asleep on the ground beside his maps.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Late into the night he was awoken by a shout from his guard. As he rose he saw, from nowhere, an assassin's arm, dagger readied. Battle-hardened reflexes saved Decius's life, and he disarmed the assassin only to watch him begin to fade from view again. Whether this was some demon or wizard, Decius knew he had better find out who sent him. He grabbed a torch and swung it at the intruder to disrupt his spell. The assassin, a human man cloaked in grey, fell to the ground screaming and Decius's guards were able to subdue him.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Interrogation revealed an iron will in the assassin, but he was able to rule out the Svartalfar, Infernals, and Calabim as a source. As he mulled over how to get a motive out of his would-be killer, a messenger arrived. An Elohim monk with word that Ethne the White had succumbed to a similar strike, and magic was useless to revive her. If the Elohim ruler was to be restored, her assailant must be tracked down. And ignoring this threat would surely lead to future attempts, which might pierce his defenses. He had hoped to reinforce a city called Bourne the Gleaming, founded by Empyrean missionaries sent shortly after the first council in the desert of Myrh. But this mission south, into the wastes, took priority. With the secrets of the Mercurian Gate that Ethne had given them, they may be able to hold out against the Infernals summoned from the Hell-fire in lands of Os-Gabella's Sheaim ally, Tebryn.
chinese: 德西乌斯指挥他的军队在坦普斯·摩尔的山麓扎营。这场战争漫长，磨砺了他所统领的马拉基姆新兵，但他们仍恪守天穹会的理想，也放过了盟友文明的些许残余。随着消息传来，塞安密探在遥远之地开启了地狱之火的门户，巴希姆与地狱军团之间那永无休止的宿仇，注定会如烈火般蔓延至世界其余各处。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]但坦普斯·摩尔终将迎来和平，范恩关于善良诸邦结盟的愿景已结出果实。德西乌斯布下守卫，走进营帐谋划下一步行动。过了一阵，他就在地图旁的地上睡着了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]夜深时分，他被守卫的一声呼喊惊醒。起身之际，他看见一条不知从何而来的刺客之臂，匕首已然备好。久经沙场的反应救了德西乌斯一命，他缴下刺客的武器，却眼看着他又开始从视野中隐去。无论此人是恶魔还是术士，德西乌斯都清楚，他最好查明是谁派来了他。他抓起一支火把朝那入侵者挥去，以扰乱他的法术。那刺客，一名身披灰袍的人类男子，尖叫着倒地，德西乌斯的守卫得以将他制服。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]审讯显出这刺客有着钢铁般的意志，但他仍得以排除斯瓦塔尔法、地狱军团与卡拉比姆是幕后主使。正当他斟酌如何从这名未遂的凶手口中套出动机时，一名信使赶到。一位埃洛希姆僧侣带来消息：白袍艾斯妮已在一次类似的袭击中殒命，魔法也无法使她复生。若要复原这位埃洛希姆的统治者，就必须追查到袭击她的凶手。而无视这一威胁，必将招致日后的行刺，那或许会刺穿他的防御。他本盼着去增援一座名为闪光伯恩的城市，那是天穹会在米尔沙漠首次议会后不久派出的传教士所建。但这次向南、深入荒原的行动更为紧要。有了艾斯妮交给他们的天界之门的秘密，他们或许能顶住那些从奥斯·加贝拉之塞安盟友特布里恩地界的地狱之火中召唤而出的地狱军团。

english: Decius watched the armies of the allied Malakim tribes array into a rough formation, each man with his arms and near his kin. There was much squabbling and joking; far from the ordered troops he had commanded on Bannor crusade. "They are not prepared for what we face, Vaughn."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We haven't embarked on a religious war before. We have no hardened crusaders among us. I count this a point in favor of the Empyrean, do you not?"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I do not count naïveté as a virtue when I march to war. Fanaticism is a vice I do not wish to import, but martial discipline will be critical if any of these men are to return."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Vicar frowned. "It would be good if we could stay longer in this desert, where we have the advantage. But if our council is to sustain us in our hard times, we must stand with the Elohim in their dark hour."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Indeed. I would prefer to train them more, but what Varn Gosam tells me is cause for immediate mobilization. There is a dark and secretive people known as the Sheaim, and their schemes have reached fruition with an Infernal Pact. Agares's archangel Hyborem has entered our world. He has struck against the Ljosalfar, allowing our old enemies the Svartalfar an advantage in their war. The Elohim have brought in another ally, a force for good but not for peace-the renegade Basium and his warriors. Weakness in this war will bring destruction to the forces of good."
chinese: 德西乌斯看着结盟的马拉基姆各部大军列成一个松散的阵形，每个人都携着自己的兵器、伴着自己的亲族。争吵与玩笑不断；这与他在班诺尔圣战中所统领的严整之师相去甚远。“他们还没准备好迎接我们所要面对的，沃恩。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们此前从未踏上过一场宗教战争。我们中间没有久经沙场的圣战士。我倒把这算作天穹会的一个优点，你不这么看吗？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我出征之时，可不把幼稚天真算作美德。狂热是我不愿引入的恶习，可若要这些人中有谁能生还，军纪便至关重要。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]那位代牧皱起眉头。“我们若能在这片对我们有利的沙漠里多留些时日就好了。但我们的议会若要在艰难时局中支撑我们，我们就必须在埃洛希姆的至暗之时与他们并肩而立。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“的确。我本更愿多加操练他们，但范恩·哥萨姆告诉我的事，足以让我们即刻动员。有一支黑暗而隐秘的民族，人称塞安，他们的阴谋已随一纸地狱契约而成真。阿加雷斯的大天使海勃雷姆已踏入我们的世界。他已向勒约沙尔法发难，让我们的宿敌斯瓦塔尔法在他们的战争中占了上风。埃洛希姆引来了另一位盟友，一股向善却不向和平的力量——叛逆者巴希姆及其战士。这场战争中的软弱，将给善之诸军带来毁灭。”

english: Ethne traveled to Golden Leane to attend the meeting of the Overcouncil. Usually an envoy went in her place, but after recent gains in their mutual struggle she decided to go in person, especially to address the plight of Sheaim and Svartalfar prisoners of war. The Malakim were a good people, but their new commander Decius struck her as overly... pragmatic. He deferred a great deal to Varn Gosam, however, and the Empyrean patriarch was a merciful elven man.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Chalid was at the council meeting, Varn Gosam's closest disciple, and another non-member: Varn's wife. Ethne greeted her before they formally began. "It is good to see you well, Talia. I think of you often when I hear of the destruction left in the wake of our enemies. There will be much work to do to return our land to order when we win here; perhaps you could aid our efforts in the savannah region Flauros has claimed."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Hmm? Oh, yes. These things trouble us all, of course. In fact, I will get a chance to see this area first hand as an envoy to the Calabim. They are unnatural monsters, but perhaps they can see that aiding this Hell on Erebus is not in their interest."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I'm sure you will be missed here as you travel."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"We all have our roles to fill, Ethne. Our desires cannot interfere with our goals."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I simply meant..." Ethne's voice trailed off as Talia took a seat between Varn and Decius.
chinese: 艾斯妮前往黄金林安，出席至高议会的会议。往常都由一名使者代她前去，但在他们共同的斗争近来有所斩获之后，她决意亲自出席，尤其是要处置塞安与斯瓦塔尔法战俘的境况。马拉基姆是善良的一族，但他们的新指挥官德西乌斯给她的印象是过于……务实了。不过他事事多有听从范恩·哥萨姆，而这位天穹会的宗主是一位仁慈的精灵。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]卡利德也在议会上，他是范恩·哥萨姆最亲近的门徒，另一位非成员是：范恩的妻子。正式开始之前，艾斯妮向她问好。“见你安好真是太好了，塔利亚。每当听闻敌人过处留下的破坏，我便常常想起你。待我们在此获胜，要让我们的土地重归秩序还有许多事要做；或许你能在弗劳诺斯所占的那片热带草原地带助我们一臂之力。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“嗯？哦，是啊。这些事自然叫我们所有人都忧心。事实上，我将有机会以出使卡拉比姆的使者身份亲眼看看那片地方。他们是些违逆自然的怪物，但或许他们能看清，助长这埃瑞布斯上的地狱并不合乎他们的利益。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你此行离去，此地定会想念你的。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我们各有其分内之责，艾斯妮。我们的心愿不能妨碍我们的目标。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我只是想说……”艾斯妮的话音渐渐低了下去，塔利亚在范恩与德西乌斯之间落了座。

english: A Svartalfar spy was waiting in Os-Gabella's chambers when she retired for the night. "This game of Faeryl's may intimidate some, but it merely annoys me to have to kill so many of her spies," Os-Gabella said.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"I come with a message, dear friend of the Svartalfar. An opportunity. A tale of conversation overheard in the palace of another friend. The wife of Varn Gosam, a woman of greatly divergent temperament, requests the Calabim withdrawal from our alliance. Decius declines the offer, overly politely. There is more here than diplomacy. A risk that Decius may be swayed, but as far as he has come, he has scant recourse to go back. If she were to have a moment of weakness though, it would stab at the heart of the Overcouncil."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Os-Gabella smiled. "Perhaps if we alienate Decius... make him lonely, to long for a companion, he would seek out this woman in the future. Make sure he knows his fortune depends on his allegiance to us, however."
chinese: 奥斯·加贝拉夜里就寝时，一名斯瓦塔尔法密探已在她的寝室中等候。“菲尔蕾尔这套把戏或许能吓住某些人，可要我杀掉她这么多密探，只让我觉得厌烦，”奥斯·加贝拉说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“我带来一则口信，斯瓦塔尔法的挚友。一个机会。一段在另一位友人宫中偶然听来的对话。范恩·哥萨姆之妻，一个脾性大相径庭的女子，请求卡拉比姆退出我们的同盟。德西乌斯拒绝了这一提议，且过分地客气。这里头不只是外交那么简单。有一种风险，德西乌斯或许会被动摇，可他既已走到这一步，便几乎无从回头。然而她若有片刻的软弱，便将刺中至高议会的心脏。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]奥斯·加贝拉微微一笑。“或许我们若疏远德西乌斯……让他孤独，让他渴望有个伴，将来他便会去寻这个女子。不过，务必让他明白，他的荣华取决于他对我们的效忠。”

english: Talia walked unescorted from the Calabim borders through the savannah. It was early morning, and she headed towards the rising sun, towards home. Decius had just released her from a captivity that she had forgotten wasn't voluntary. He had fascinated her, and she had betrayed her husband Varn Gosam to her baser instincts. But she learned much of the man whose armies opposed hers, and she comforted herself with the thought that this information might aid her people in stopping the Calabim.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Do you know how the Sea of Sorrow was named?" The voice came from the shadows of a rock formation as she passed by.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Who's there? I have been granted passage as a prisoner exchange by Decius of the Calabim."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]An old crone in dusty purple robes emerged from the shadows. "There once was a great king who ruled over this land. Lord of all he would survey. His palace stood on a cliff overlooking the sea on the western edge." She paused.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Talia gave her no further prompting. "I have no time for your story. I am too long delayed from my home already." She turned away and hurried on, but found the woman ahead of her.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"It is his sorrow from which this sea draws its name. A great king who had everything he asked for given. And he climbed the tower stairs to throw himself to his death in the crashing sea beneath."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"What concern is this of mine? Kings come and go; all creatures suffer. I must return to my people, who struggle with a threat to every living thing under the sun!" The dust around her feet rose swirling around her, cutting off the old woman, and again Talia turned towards home.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This time she saw the woman step from thin air in front of her. "What caused a sorrow so great to make him disdain his own life? Do you not know the story?" The Crone looked into Talia's eyes, who this time held her gaze. "That which he most treasured was shown to be false. A promise shown a lie. A wife shown untrue."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"Spirit be gone! Do not... do not judge me."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"The king's greatest desire was for his trusted queen to stand loyally by his side and help him to rule justly. He was too kind to send her away, too wise to trust her again, too idealistic to live with his dream out of reach. His death was the only solution within his grasp."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"It would be better had he never learned of this," Talia said softly.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"He will learn of it," the Crone said.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"He should... he can take another."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]"He is too true to do that. The king could not be happy... not while the queen who betrayed him still lived."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The old woman turned away, releasing Talia from her gaze. Talia shook her head, then turned away, running towards home.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The crone's ancient façade faded away. She removed a small mirror from her robes, and sprinkled a powder over it, revealing a dreary castle in a hellish landscape. "The seeds are planted, Lethe. Follow this one. Take her guilt and pain as supplication, and lead her to your embrace."[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Then after one final look to the fleeing Talia, Os-Gabella spoke a arcane command and returned to her palace.
chinese: 塔利亚无人护送，独自从卡拉比姆的边境穿过热带草原。时值清晨，她朝着初升的太阳走去，朝着家的方向。德西乌斯刚刚放她离开那段她早已忘了并非出于自愿的囚禁。他曾令她着迷，她也曾对丈夫范恩·哥萨姆不忠，屈从于自己更低劣的本能。但她对那位其军队与她为敌之人了解甚多，她以这样一个念头安慰自己：这些情报或许能助她的族人阻止卡拉比姆。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“你可知悲痛之海因何得名？”她路过之时，那声音自一处岩层的阴影中传来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“谁在那里？我是卡拉比姆的德西乌斯以战俘交换之名准许通行的。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]一个身着满是尘土的紫袍的老妪从阴影中走出。“很久以前，有一位伟大的国王统治着这片土地。他目之所及，皆是他的领地。他的宫殿矗立在西缘一处俯瞰大海的悬崖之上。”她顿了顿。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]塔利亚没有再催促她。“我没工夫听你的故事。我离家已经耽搁得太久了。”她转身匆匆前行，却发现那女子已在她前头。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“正是他的悲痛，为这片海赐了名。一位伟大的国王，所求的一切皆得应许。他却登上塔梯，纵身跃入下方翻腾的大海赴死。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“这与我何干？国王来来去去；一切生灵皆受苦难。我必须回到我的族人身边，他们正与一个威胁着日光之下每一个生灵的威胁苦苦相搏！”她脚边的尘土旋卷而起，绕着她盘旋，隔断了那老妪，塔利亚再度转身朝家的方向走去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]这一次，她看见那女子凭空从她面前现身。“究竟是何等巨大的悲痛，令他鄙弃了自己的性命？你难道不知这故事？”老妪直视塔利亚的双眼，这一回塔利亚迎住了她的目光。“他最珍视之物被证实是虚假的。一个诺言被证实是谎言。一位妻子被证实并不忠贞。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“魂灵，走开！别……别评判我。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“这国王最大的心愿，便是他所信赖的王后忠贞地立于他身侧，助他公正地治国。他太过仁慈，不忍将她逐走，又太过明智，无法再度信她，更太过理想主义，无法在梦想遥不可及的情形下苟活。死亡是他所能企及的唯一解脱。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“他若从未得知此事就好了，”塔利亚轻声说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“他会得知的，”老妪说。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“他应该……他可以另娶一位。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“他太过忠贞，做不出那种事。这国王无法快乐……只要那背叛他的王后还活着。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]老妪转过身去，将塔利亚从她的目光中释放。塔利亚摇了摇头，随即转身，朝家的方向奔去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]老妪那古老的外表消融而去。她从袍中取出一面小镜，在镜上撒了些粉末，映出一片地狱般景致中的一座阴郁城堡。“种子已经播下，莱丝。跟住这一个。以她的愧疚与痛苦为供奉，引她投入你的怀抱。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]随后，在朝那奔逃的塔利亚投去最后一瞥之后，奥斯·加贝拉念出一句奥法的号令，返回了她的宫殿。

english: Duke Sallos appears in the official Scenarios.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Sallos was a soldier from a small and dismal duchy at the edge of the patrian empire. He grew tired of what he thought was a meaningless life. When he captured a Merry Dancer he sacrificed the creature in the hope that something will hear his call. His call was heard and Hyborem answered and offered him seven years of power in exchange for his eternal servitude and that of his descendants (his wife was pregnant with their son Asmodey at the time). Sallos accepted.[PARAGRAPH:1]In those seven years Sallos rose to become a patrian duke. After the time was over he died suddenly and after surviving the torments of hell, he became a ruler there as well.[PARAGRAPH:1]It is unusual for a mortal soul to rise to a duke in the demonic ranks. He maintains his status because his descendants remain devout to Sallos's pledge. They have formed a family secret society called the Daughters of Saleos based on demonic worship and incest (to keep their bloodline of Sallos pure).
chinese: 萨洛斯公爵在官方剧本中登场。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]萨洛斯原是帕特里亚帝国边陲一座又小又阴郁的公国里的一名士兵。他厌倦了自认为毫无意义的生活。当他俘获一名欢舞者时，便将这个生灵献祭出去，指望有什么东西能听到他的呼唤。他的呼唤被听见了，海勃雷姆作出回应，提出以七年的权力换取他与其后裔永世的效忠（当时他的妻子正怀着他们的儿子阿斯莫迪）。萨洛斯答应了。[PARAGRAPH:1]在那七年里，萨洛斯一路攀升，成了帕特里亚的一位公爵。期限一到，他便骤然死去；在熬过地狱的种种折磨之后，他在那里也成了统治者。[PARAGRAPH:1]凡人的灵魂能在恶魔的等级中晋升为公爵，实属罕见。他之所以能保住这一地位，是因为他的后裔始终恪守萨洛斯当年立下的誓约。他们组成了一个名为“萨莱奥斯之女”的家族秘密结社，奉行恶魔崇拜与乱伦（以保持萨洛斯血脉的纯正）。

english: Meresin appears in the official Scenarios.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Also known as Father Whisper. Meresin was the headmaster of an orphanage and horribly mistreated the children in his care. He would offer the services of his orphanage to surrounding cities and then claim that the children had run away when most were locked beneath the orphanage until they no longer amused him, and then burnt alive in the ophanage's crematorium. He would use a barbed flail on the children, and occasionally himself.[PARAGRAPH:1]Though he was investigated, and a few children came close to escaping, Meresin was never caught and he tortured and killed hundreds of children in his life. It wasn't until a plague spread through the city, and Meresin began collecting the newly orphaned (and sick) children that he also contracted the plague that killed him. Then the town found the cellar where children were still caged and the floor was covered with ash and bones.[PARAGRAPH:1]The orphanage is still haunted by the spirits of the children that died there. Ghosts that linger in the crematorium and a Caller in the Darkness that dwells in the cellar. Children that pass too close to the ruins (especially at night) are drawn to them. An elohim priestess attempted to sanctify the ruins the the Age of Rebirth but was killed in the attempt and now her spirit wanders the area trying to find someone else to break the curse.[PARAGRAPH:1]After his death Meresin became a demon, his focus is on runaways. He is the voice that calls from the shadows, the comfort for the lost, and the voice that stokes the flames of anger and rebellion against parents. He still carries his barbed flail. If Meresin is summoned he can curse enemies with a disease that causes them to sweat blood or invoke feelings of lust, but he requires a living child in trade.
chinese: 梅尔森在官方剧本中登场。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]又名“低语神父”。梅尔森曾是一家孤儿院的院长，对他照管的孩子极尽虐待。他会把孤儿院的“服务”提供给周边城镇，随后声称孩子们逃走了，而事实上大多数孩子被关押在孤儿院地下，直到再也无法取悦他，便被活活烧死在孤儿院的焚化炉里。他会用带倒刺的连枷抽打孩子，偶尔也抽打自己。[PARAGRAPH:1]尽管有人对他展开过调查，也有几个孩子险些逃脱，梅尔森却始终未被抓获，他一生折磨并杀害了数百名儿童。直到一场瘟疫在城中蔓延，梅尔森开始收留新近失去双亲（且染病）的孩子，这才染上瘟疫，命丧于此。随后镇上的人发现了那间地窖，里面仍关着被囚的孩子，地面上覆满灰烬与骸骨。[PARAGRAPH:1]那座孤儿院至今仍被死在那里的孩子们的亡魂萦绕。有徘徊在焚化炉里的幽灵，还有栖身地窖中的“黑暗召唤者”。凡是靠得太近废墟的孩子（尤其在夜里）都会被它们吸引过去。一位埃洛希姆女祭司曾在重生纪元试图净化这片废墟，却在过程中丧命，如今她的灵魂在此地游荡，想找到另一个能破除诅咒的人。[PARAGRAPH:1]梅尔森死后成了恶魔，他专注于离家出走者。他是从阴影中呼唤的声音，是迷途者的慰藉，也是那煽动怒火、教唆孩子背叛父母的声音。他仍握着那把带倒刺的连枷。若召唤梅尔森，他能以令敌人渗出血汗的疾病诅咒他们，或勾起他们的淫欲，但他索要一个活着的孩子作为交换。

english: Minister Koun can enter the game after an Event in which a City requests freedom from your Civilization. There is a 50% chance for him to either start out on the Mother Civilization's Team, or independent (chance is determined at the start of the game). The Event to bring Minister Koun into the game will only appear in approximately 1/3 of all games played. All attributes of Minister Koun except his Traits will be based on the Mother Civilization (thus he shares the same Unique Buildings, Unique Units, Civilization Trait and World Spell). He will start in control of the Liberated City with 4 Archers and 1 Worker. Minister Koun appears in the official Scenarios and  can also lead a revolution if the Revolutions Gameoption is enabled.
chinese: 权臣寇恩会在一场“某城市请求脱离你的文明”的事件之后进入游戏。他有 50% 的概率或是站在母文明一方开局，或是独立开局（该概率在游戏开始时确定）。将权臣寇恩带入游戏的事件仅在约 1/3 的对局中出现。除特性外，权臣寇恩的所有属性都以母文明为基础（因此他共享相同的特色建筑、特色单位、文明特性与世界法术）。他将掌控那座获得解放的城市开局，麾下有 4 名弓箭手和 1 名工人。权臣寇恩在官方剧本中登场，若启用“革命”游戏选项也可领导一场革命。

english: Ouzza appears in the official Scenarios.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]When Asmodey required the sacrifice of a child from every village, Ouzza's village (including his own father) offered him to curry favor with the powerful duke. First his mind was sacrificed by forcing him to imbibe a consecrated bottle of blood god wine, then his body was sacrificed, piece by piece. Finally, while he lay dying his soul was sacrificed to Agares.[PARAGRAPH:1]Agares accepted the gift. And eventually Ouzza returned as a demon to claim a part of the villagers that so easily offered him up. From some a tongue, from others an eye, from some, a portion of their mind or soul.[PARAGRAPH:1]In battle, Ouzza can summon serpents from inside the body of living targets and his gaze causes paralysis. He carries a bloody machete with which he can remove limbs and a ritual knife for removing internal organs, which he usually does while his victims are still alive and paralyzed. Ouzza's magic will not work on those willing to sacrifice themselves to save others.[PARAGRAPH:1]Ouzza (who is also known as the Call of the Altar or Fleshcaller) answers prayers from those who have lost a body part and he can provide a replacement, though a corrupt version, and he expects a personal sacrifice of some type from the one calling him.

english: [H1]Multiple Production[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]This game option changes how production overflow is handled in cities. When production overflow floods from overflow capacity, it is used in the next queue item immediately, not converted into gold. When the production overflow in a city is high enough to finish the next item or items in the production queue, they will be finished in the same turn too.[PARAGRAPH:2]This rule is not applied to Rituals and Wonders, as it could allow to accumulate overflow in order to build them faster once that their requirements are met. Production overflow isn't carried from normal production to items produced using food or viceversa, as that would allow to prevent halting city growth by accumulating enough overflow. Production overflow is carried between items produced with food in the same way it happens for normal production.
chinese: [H1]多重生产[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]这个游戏选项改变了城市中生产溢出的处理方式。当生产溢出超过溢出上限而外泄时，它会立即用于队列中的下一个项目，而不是转化为金币。当一座城市的生产溢出足够完成生产队列中的下一个或多个项目时，它们也会在同一回合内完成。[PARAGRAPH:2]此规则不适用于仪式和奇观，因为那样就能通过积累溢出，在满足要求后更快地建造它们。生产溢出不会从常规生产转到用食物生产的项目上，反之亦然，否则就能靠积累足够的溢出来避免城市停止增长。用食物生产的各项目之间会像常规生产那样相互结转生产溢出。

[H1]Puppet States[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Puppet States can be formed when a civilization with knowledge of how to form Vassal States conquers a city. Puppet States are created as a Vassal of the conquering player, and are the same civilization type as the previous city owner. Puppet States are a special type of vassal in that they don't get a Palace and are permanently a Vassal unless they achieve Legitimacy. A Puppet State achieves Legitimacy when it is the last remaining civ of it's civilization type. At that point it becomes a regular Vassal rather than a Puppet State.

english: [H1]Advanced Diplomacy[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Advanced Diplomacy (enabled via the Advanced tactics option) vastly changes the way diplomacy works from standard Civilization. Many new trading options are added, each with their own benefits, and potiential disadvantages. What follows is a list of the new options. (Warning: incomplete)[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Embassies.[\\BOLD] Nations can now establish embassies in other nations. Embassies improve diplomatic relations between countries over time, but be warned; revoking a foreign embassies rights will have disastrous diplomatic repercussions with the other nation. Embassies are now required to unlock higher diplomatic functions with other nations, namely, [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Open Borders Agreements[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Defensive Pacts[COLOR_REVERT], and some new options (see below). Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2] [BOLD]Right of Passage.[\\BOLD] Similar to open borders, in that it allows foreign trade, but the agreement only allows for defensive units and scouts to pass through the nations. Other units will not be able to enter the territory. Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Free Trade Agreement.[\\BOLD] This agreement increases gold from trading missions and improves diplomatic relations over time. Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK] and [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Open borders[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:2] [BOLD]Non-Aggression Pact.[\\BOLD] The AI is somewhat less likely to attack a player with whom it has a non-agression pact. Also improves diplomatic relations over time. Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK] and [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Embassy[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Trading Military Units and Workers.[\\BOLD] Workers and certain Military units, like siege machines, can be traded. Each tradable unit will be marked in it's respective civilopedia entry with "This unit is tradable." Requires [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Embassy[COLOR_REVERT].
chinese: [H1]高级外交[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]高级外交（通过“高级战术”选项启用）极大地改变了外交在标准文明中的运作方式。新增了许多贸易选项，各有其收益，也各有潜在的弊端。下面列出这些新选项。（警告：尚不完整）[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]大使馆。[\\BOLD]各国如今可以在他国设立大使馆。大使馆会随时间改善两国间的外交关系，但请注意：撤销外国大使馆的权利会给与该国的外交带来灾难性的后果。如今，要解锁与他国更高级的外交功能——即[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]开放边境协定[COLOR_REVERT]、[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]防御同盟[COLOR_REVERT]以及一些新选项（见下文）——都需要先设立大使馆。需要[LINK=TECH_WRITING]文字[\\LINK]。[PARAGRAPH:2] [BOLD]通行权。[\\BOLD]与开放边境类似，同样允许外国通行，但该协定只允许防御单位和侦察兵通过本国领土。其他单位无法进入。需要[LINK=TECH_WRITING]文字[\\LINK]。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]自由贸易协定。[\\BOLD]该协定提升贸易任务所得的金钱，并随时间改善外交关系。需要[LINK=TECH_WRITING]文字[\\LINK]与[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]开放边境[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:2] [BOLD]互不侵犯条约。[\\BOLD]AI 攻击与其签有互不侵犯条约的玩家的可能性会略微降低，同时也随时间改善外交关系。需要[LINK=TECH_WRITING]文字[\\LINK]与[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]大使馆[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]交易军事单位与工人。[\\BOLD]工人以及某些军事单位（如攻城器械）可被交易。每种可交易的单位都会在其对应的文明百科条目中标注"此单位可被交易。"需要[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]大使馆[COLOR_REVERT]。

english: [H1]Active Senate[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Under some types of government ([LINK=CIVIC_REPRESENTATION]Representation[\\LINK], [LINK=CIVIC_UNIVERSAL_SUFFRAGE]Universal Suffrage[\\LINK]), the Senate can interfere with your military policy. Thus, it may invalidate your declarations of war and/or force you to sign a peace treaty with your enemies.[PARAGRAPH:2]The decisions of the Senate depend in particular on the scale of the conflict, either potential or actual, and its real interest. Thus, pursue a policy military under democratic regime becomes more difficult.[PARAGRAPH:2] However, when an opponent make unpleasant acts to your nation, by a embargo, a negative vote, an espionage mission, etc. ..., you have a sufficient pretext to go to war without Senate intervention. Any war pretext is valid for one turn and throughout the conflict in case of a declaration of war. Of course, malicious acts of enemies who are already at war against you are a pretext to circumvent the Senate.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]
chinese: [H1]活跃元老院[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]在某些政体下（[LINK=CIVIC_REPRESENTATION]代议制[\\LINK]、[LINK=CIVIC_UNIVERSAL_SUFFRAGE]普选制[\\LINK]），元老院会干预你的军事政策。因此，它可能否决你的宣战，或迫使你与敌人签订和约。[PARAGRAPH:2]元老院的决定尤其取决于冲突的规模（无论是潜在的还是实际的）及其切身利益。因此，在民主政体下推行军事政策会变得更加困难。[PARAGRAPH:2]然而，当对手对你的国家做出不友善的举动，例如禁运、投反对票、间谍任务等等，你便有充分的借口不经元老院干预即可开战。任何开战借口在一个回合内有效，且在宣战情形下贯穿整场冲突。当然，已经对你开战之敌的恶意举动，本身就是绕开元老院的借口。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]

english: [H1]Condamned Civic[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]The United Nations can vote on resolution of condemnation of a civic. If and only if this civic is adopted by one of the voting players. Are condemnable by the United Nations, some of the most extremist civics. [PARAGRAPH:2]Choosing a condemned civic generate a diplomatic penalty from the voting members and exclude the civilization to the clan of members which can vote, which in itself is not always a bad thing (as you assess the risks and benefits of such a situation.)[PARAGRAPH:2]It is possible that a AI player proposes such a resolution and pass it, in which case it can influence the course of the game. But from a human point of view, the interest is more subtile. It allows to turn some civilizations against another. Indeed, if you want to attack an opponent who has a state religion shared by you and your allies, but he chose a different religious doctrine, you can try to condemn it to make it a pariat and attack without offending your brothers in faith, even with their assistance.[PARAGRAPH:2]From a historical point of view, the interest is basically to be able to condemn the reform among others.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]
chinese: [H1]受谴责政策[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]联合国可以就谴责某项政策的决议进行投票。当且仅当该政策被某个参与投票的玩家采用时方可谴责。可被联合国谴责的，是一些最为极端的政策。[PARAGRAPH:2]选择受谴责政策会招致投票成员的外交惩罚，并将该文明排除在可投票的成员集团之外——这本身未必是坏事（你需要权衡此种处境的风险与收益）。[PARAGRAPH:2]AI 玩家有可能提出并通过这样的决议，此时它会影响游戏进程。但从人类玩家的角度看，其意义更为微妙。它可以使某些文明反目成仇。事实上，如果你想攻击一个与你及盟友共享国教、却选择了不同宗教教义的对手，你可以设法谴责它，使其沦为弃儿，从而在不冒犯信仰弟兄的情况下发动攻击，甚至得到他们的协助。[PARAGRAPH:2]从历史角度看，其意义主要在于能够谴责诸如改革之类的政策。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]
